name: nail_detection_v1
description: Initial nail detection dataset for width measurement. Contains images of thumbs and four-finger captures on credit cards.

classes.name: credit_card
classes.description: Credit card used as size reference (85.6mm x 53.98mm)

capture_scenarios.thumb_on_card: Single thumb placed on credit card, nail facing camera
capture_scenarios.four_fingers_on_card: Index, middle, ring, little fingers aligned on credit card

annotation_guidelines.bounding_box: Tight box around nail area only, excluding cuticle and skin
annotation_guidelines.width_priority: Ensure left and right edges are precisely marked for width measurement
